model_number: PlayStation 2 DVD-ROM game disc (NTSC-U/C, 120 mm, single-sided; SLUS/SCUS)
frame: Disc lying flat, label side up (+Y), data (read) side down (-Y). Root = disc center, Y=0 at mid-thickness (label surface Y=+0.6, data surface Y=-0.6). Label 2D positions below are [u, v] in mm viewed from +Y: u = +X, v = label 'up' = -Z.

data_side_holograms.desc: molded 'PlayStation 2' wordmark + PS logo holograms in the clear hub band, visible from both sides

data_side_ps_logo_watermarks.desc: six faint PS logos in the reflective data area (1,3,5,7,9,11 o'clock)

label_elements_ntscuc.desc: Sony NTSC-U/C label layout (measured on SCUS 97395). Runtime label texture replaces all of this; positions only.

ps_logo_box.style: white outline square, white PS family logo

legal_text_block.note: block above hub on this disc; many retail discs run the licensing text as an arc near the rim instead

materials.data_side: metallic 1.0, roughness ~0.08, thin-film/anisotropic rainbow optional; under the 0.6 mm clear substrate
materials.hub: clear polycarbonate, IOR 1.585, transmission ~0.9 (between hole and label_inner_d, and non-metallized to 41 mm on data side)
materials.label: matte screen print, roughness ~0.5

notes: Geometry from ECMA-267 3rd ed. (2001) section 10: d=120.00+-0.30, hole 15.00 (+0.15/-0), e1=1.20 (+0.30/-0.06), clamping zone 22.0-33.0, third transition area 33-44 (stacking features allowed, +0.25 max), information zone from 44.0 / data zone 48.0-116.0, info zone ends >=117.0, rim edge round <=0.2. Label printed-area inner 24 mm measured on PS2dvd.jpg (white label edge seen through the clear hub, circle fit, hole=15.0 check) and HDD Utility disc label photo; outer 117 per edocpublish full-face spec. PS2 DVD-ROM data side is SILVER; the 'blue' data side belongs to early PS2 CD-ROM titles (Wikipedia: 'earlier titles ... blue-tinted CD-ROM'); blue value provided as alternate. See PS2_Disc_Case/REFERENCE_NOTES.md.
